changes.why: v0.9.0 removed the car alias of head (commit 'remove R.car, R.cdr, and R.cons')
v0.9.0 removed the cdr alias of tail
v0.9.0 removed the cons alias of prepend
v0.9.0 removed the push alias of append
v0.9.0 removed size; its alias length became the function itself
v0.9.0 renamed repeatN to repeat (same code); R.repeatN is gone
v0.9.0 unified clone, cloneObj and cloneDeep into clone; R.cloneDeep is gone
v0.9.0 removed R.alwaysZero
v0.9.0 renamed alwaysFalse to F (same code: always(false))
v0.9.0 renamed alwaysTrue to T (same code: always(true))
v0.9.0 removed R.reduce (foldl, its alias since v0.4.0, keeps the code)
v0.9.0 removed R.reduceRight (foldr, its alias since v0.4.1, keeps the code)
v0.9.0 removed reduce and its .idx property; the indexed left fold is now foldlIndexed
v0.9.0 renamed foldl.idx to foldlIndexed
v0.9.0 removed reduceRight and its .idx property; the indexed right fold is now foldrIndexed
v0.9.0 renamed foldr.idx to foldrIndexed
v0.9.0 renamed map.idx to mapIndexed (commit 'rename .idx functions')
v0.9.0 renamed mapObj.idx to mapObjIndexed
v0.9.0 renamed filter.idx to filterIndexed
v0.9.0 renamed reject.idx to rejectIndexed
v0.9.0 renamed skip to drop (same code)
v0.9.0 replaced skipUntil with dropWhile, which skips while the predicate holds (the negated test)
v0.9.0 renamed every to all (same code)
v0.9.0 renamed some to any (same code)
v0.9.0 removed R.indexOf.from
v0.9.0 removed R.lastIndexOf.from
v0.9.0 removed R.slice.from
v0.9.0 unified clone, cloneObj and cloneDeep into clone; R.cloneObj is gone
v0.9.0 renamed allPredicates to allPass
v0.9.0 renamed anyPredicates to anyPass
v0.9.0 removed the alias R['if'] of ifElse
v0.9.0 renamed toUpperCase to toUpper (same code)
v0.9.0 renamed toLowerCase to toLower (same code)

v0.9.0's clone is v0.8.0's cloneDeep, a deep copy of any value (_baseCopy), where it copied a list (_slice): the signature generalises from clone<T>(list: seq<T>): seq<T> to clone<T>(value: T): T (clone({a: 1}) went from RangeError to {a: 1}); list results unchanged
v0.9.0 takes the default first: propOr(val, p, obj) (was propOr(p, val, obj)); propOr(7, 'a', {a: 1}) went from 'a' to 1
v0.9.0 removed reduce, which held the definition; foldl (_curry3(_foldl)) carries the fold, so the revealed body is reduce's recursion instead of a call of reduce, same results
v0.9.0 removed reduceRight, which held the definition; foldr carries the right fold itself, so the revealed body is reduceRight's recursion, same results
v0.9.0 removed size and made length its own function (list.length, NaN for non-lists): the revealed body is |list| instead of size(list), same results
v0.9.0's commuteMap folds with _foldl and reduce is gone: the revealed body calls foldl instead of reduce, same results
knock-on of foldl: its revealed body calls foldl, whose body changed; same results
knock-on of foldl: its revealed body calls foldl, whose body changed; same results
knock-on of commuteMap: its revealed body calls commuteMap, whose body changed; same results
new in v0.9.0 (@category Type): R.isNil(x) = x == null, true for null and undefined; ported over Option<T>, None standing for both
new name in v0.9.0 for alwaysTrue, same code: always(true)
new name in v0.9.0 for alwaysFalse, same code: always(false)
new name in v0.9.0 for every (_curry2(_all)): fn holds for every element
new name in v0.9.0 for some (_curry2(_any)): fn holds for some element
new name in v0.9.0 for skip, same code: all but the first n elements, [] when n >= length
new in v0.9.0 in place of skipUntil: drops the leading elements that satisfy pred
new name in v0.9.0 for repeatN, same code (times(always(value), n)); @category List puts it in List
new name in v0.9.0 for filter.idx, same code
new name in v0.9.0 for reject.idx, same code
new name in v0.9.0 for map.idx, same code
new name in v0.9.0 for mapObj.idx, same code
new name in v0.9.0 for foldl.idx/reduce.idx, same code: acc = fn(acc, list[idx], idx, list) for idx ascending
new name in v0.9.0 for foldr.idx/reduceRight.idx, same code: acc = fn(acc, list[idx], idx, list) for idx descending
new in v0.9.0: R.init = slice(0, -1), all but the last element
new in v0.9.0: R.mapAccumL(fn, acc, list) threads acc left to right through fn(acc, x) = [acc', y], returning [acc, ys]
new in v0.9.0: R.mapAccumR, as mapAccumL from the right, each y kept at its element's index
new in v0.9.0: R.evolve(transformations, object), a copy of object with each transformed key set to fn(object[key]) (undefined when absent)
new in v0.9.0: R.invert(obj), each value mapped to the keys holding it
new in v0.9.0: R.invertObj(obj), each value mapped to its key (values distinct here)
new name in v0.9.0 for allPredicates (_predicateWrap(_all))
new name in v0.9.0 for anyPredicates (_predicateWrap(_any))
new in v0.9.0: R.inc = add(1)
new in v0.9.0: R.dec = add(-1)
new in v0.9.0: R.negate = multiply(-1)
new name in v0.9.0 for toUpperCase, same code
new name in v0.9.0 for toLowerCase, same code
new in v0.9.0 (@category Relation): R.eqDeep(a, b), deep structural equality
